introSection.heading: Understanding Princess Cruises Beverage Packages
introSection.p1: Choosing a drink package on a Princess cruise can make onboard spending easier to manage, particularly if you enjoy cocktails, wine, specialty coffee, soft drinks or bottled water. Princess offers several beverage options, from packages that include alcoholic drinks to plans designed for guests who prefer non-alcoholic beverages.
introSection.p2: The challenge is understanding which package includes what, how much it costs and whether it offers better value than paying for drinks individually.
introSection.p3: This guide compares the Princess Plus Beverage Package, Premier Beverage Package, Zero-Alcohol Package and Classic Soda Package. It also explains how the beverage benefits work within Princess Plus and Princess Premier, including daily drink limits, exclusions and ways to decide whether a package is worthwhile.

atAGlance.title: Princess Cruises Drink Packages at a Glance
atAGlance.subtitle: Four distinct beverage packages tailored to different drinking preferences, available standalone or bundled within cruise fares.

items.title: Plus Beverage Package
items.description: Cocktails, wine by the glass, beer, spirits and a range of non-alcoholic drinks, subject to the package's per-drink price limit ($15 USD) and daily restrictions (15 included drinks per day).

items.title: Premier Beverage Package
items.description: A broader premium beverage selection with a higher per-drink price limit ($20 USD) and no daily limit on included alcoholic beverages under current terms.
bullets: No daily limit on included alcoholic drinks

items.title: Zero-Alcohol Package
items.description: Specialty coffees, gourmet teas, artisan mocktails, fountain sodas, selected bottled water, frappes and Red Bull energy drinks without alcohol.

items.title: Classic Soda Package
items.description: A simpler, value-driven option focused on fountain sodas, juices, mocktails and smoothies for travelers who do not need alcohol or specialty coffee.

importantNotesCards.title: Standalone Value vs. Cruise Bundles
importantNotesCards.description: Princess's beverage page displays $64.99 and $84.99 as the respective Plus and Premier Beverage Package values. These should not be confused with the separately priced Princess Plus ($70–$75/day) and Princess Premier ($105–$110/day) cruise packages. Confirm the actual standalone package price in Manage Booking for your sailing.

importantNotesCards.title: Service Charges & Currency Variations
importantNotesCards.description: Princess states that beverage package pricing is in USD, excludes applicable service charges and can vary with currency exchange rates. Its published beverage page lists a 20% service charge for itineraries other than Australia. Check the terms displayed for your voyage before calculating the final cost.
bullets: Exchange rates apply to foreign currencies

plusPackage.title: Plus Beverage Package: What Is Included?
plusPackage.subtitle: Designed for guests who want a broad range of drinks without paying separately for every eligible order.
plusPackage.intro: Under Princess's current published terms, eligible beverages can cost up to $15 USD per drink. The exact brands and menu selections vary by ship and venue.

items: Cocktails and mixed drinks up to $15 USD
Spirits and premium liquors up to $15 USD
Wine by the glass up to $15 USD
Craft, draft, and bottled beers up to $15 USD
Specialty coffees and teas (espresso, lattes, herbal teas)
Selected bottled water (500 ml or less)
Fresh juices and smoothies where offered

dailyLimit.title: Daily Beverage Limit Rules
dailyLimit.p1: Princess Plus has a daily limit of 15 included beverages over a 24-hour period, generally tracked from 6 a.m. to 6 a.m.
dailyLimit.p2: The limit applies to the included beverages covered by the package, not just alcoholic drinks. However, specialty coffees and teas do not count toward the 15-drink limit. Bottled sparkling or still water in containers of 500 ml or less is also excluded from that count but has its own limit of up to 12 bottles per day.
dailyLimit.p3: You cannot choose which eligible drinks are counted toward the daily allowance. The ship's point-of-sale system tracks package usage automatically.

plusPackage.additionalBenefits: The Plus Beverage Package also provides a 25% discount on selected excluded purchases, including wine bottles, one-litre bottles of water and canned soda.

premierPackage.title: Premier Beverage Package: What Is Included?
premierPackage.subtitle: A broader premium selection with higher per-drink allowances and no daily limit on included alcoholic drinks.
premierPackage.intro: Under current published terms, eligible drinks can cost up to $20 USD each. Princess highlights a selection of more than 75 spirits, 40 wines by the glass and 20 high-end crafted cocktails on its beverage information page.

items: Top-shelf spirits and aged liquors up to $20 USD
Premium crafted specialty cocktails up to $20 USD
Curated reserve wines by the glass up to $20 USD
Premium beers and international craft ales
Selected zero-alcohol cocktails and artisan mocktails
Unlimited specialty espresso coffees and organic teas
Fountain sodas and selected bottled water
Frappes and specialty shakes at Coffee & Cones

dailyLimit.title: Is There a Daily Drink Limit on Premier?
dailyLimit.p1: The current Premier Beverage Package terms state that there is no daily limit on included alcoholic beverages.
dailyLimit.p2: This does not mean unlimited service without restrictions. All alcohol service remains subject to Princess's responsible-service policies, bartender discretion, venue availability and package exclusions.

premierPackage.additionalBenefits: Premier also provides a 25% discount on selected excluded purchases, including wine bottles, one-litre bottles of water and canned soda.

exclusions.title: What Is Not Included in Princess Drink Packages?
exclusions.subtitle: A drink package covers eligible beverages, not every item sold onboard. Common exclusions include:
intro: A drink package covers eligible beverages, not every item sold onboard.
Review the key package boundaries, excluded items, and discount opportunities before placing your order.

items.title: Bottles of Wine
items.description: Full bottles of wine are not included in either package, but qualify for a 25% discount off the menu price.

items.title: One-Litre Water Bottles
items.description: Large one-litre bottles of still or sparkling water are excluded, but eligible for a 25% discount.

items.title: Canned Soda
items.description: Canned soft drinks are excluded from standard package pours (fountain sodas are included), qualifying for 25% off.

items.title: Drinks Exceeding Price Caps
items.description: Any drink priced above $15 on Plus or $20 on Premier is subject to additional menu charges for the difference or full venue price.

items.title: In-Stateroom Mini-Bar
items.description: Items ordered or consumed from the in-stateroom mini-bar are charged separately.

items.title: Vending & Self-Service
items.description: Drinks obtained from automated vending machines or self-service beverage stations are not covered.

items.title: Souvenir Glassware
items.description: Souvenir cups, commemorative glasses, drink buckets and presentation vessels carry extra charges.

items.title: Tobacco & Food Items
items.description: Cigars, cigarettes, specialty snacks and food items sold in bars are strictly excluded from all drink packages.

logisticsBento.title: How Princess Drink Packages Work & Island Policies
logisticsBento.subtitle: Essential policies, operational rules, and private island guidelines every cruiser must know.

items.title: Voyage Duration
items.description: Beverage packages are generally purchased for the full cruise length rather than selected individual days.

items.title: Sharing Policy
items.description: Packages cannot be shared. Each package is assigned to an individual guest and cannot be transferred to another passenger.

items.title: Cancellation Terms
items.description: Packages are non-refundable within three days of sailing under Princess's published conditions. Review terms before buying.

items.title: Service Gratuities
items.description: Princess's published beverage page lists a 20% service charge for itineraries other than Australia. Check your sailing's checkout terms.

items.title: Age Restrictions
items.description: Drinking age depends on the departure port. Underage guests automatically receive the Zero-Alcohol Package in place of alcoholic plans.

items.title: US Departure Limits
items.description: On sailings from CA, MA, NY, TX, VA, or WA, the alcoholic portion of the package does not take effect until the ship enters international waters.

items.title: Princess Cays & Half Moon Cay
items.description: Princess's current Plus and Premier beverage terms allow eligible package beverages on Princess private islands.

items.title: Celebration Key Exclusion
items.description: Package terms specifically exclude Celebration Key. Venue availability and drinks offered ashore may differ from onboard.

valueEvaluation.title: Do You Need a Drink Package on a Princess Cruise?
valueEvaluation.subtitle: Comparing expected daily spending against package prices to determine whether purchasing a package or paying individually delivers better value.
whenWorthIt: You enjoy multiple cocktails, beers or glasses of wine each day (4+ alcoholic drinks daily).
You regularly order specialty espresso coffees, bottled water and premium non-alcoholic drinks.
You want predictable beverage spending without tracking each itemized receipt.
You prefer premium spirits or higher-priced reserve wines by the glass.
You are booking the complete Princess Plus or Premier cruise bundle, which includes Wi-Fi, casual dining, and crew appreciation.
whenPayIndividually: You drink mostly complimentary beverages (tap water, brewed buffet coffee, iced tea, lemonade).
You rarely order alcohol or limit yourself to one occasional cocktail per sailing.
You prefer water, tea or standard coffee and rarely order specialty drinks.
You spend long days in port and will not use onboard drink benefits for most of the day.
Your calculated daily drink spend remains comfortably below the $64.99 or $84.99 package cost.
valueEvaluation.calculationP1: Compare the package's actual daily cost ($64.99 or $84.99) with the total you expect to spend on eligible beverages each day.
valueEvaluation.calculationP2: Estimate how many eligible cocktails, specialty coffees, beers, or mocktails you would order and their individual menu prices. If your total is comfortably below the package cost, paying individually is more economical.
valueEvaluation.calculationP3: For the broader Princess Plus or Premier packages, account for bundled Wi-Fi, crew appreciation (gratuities), and casual dining allowances. Comparing the beverage benefit alone would miss a significant portion of its overall vacation value.

howToChoose.title: How to Choose the Right Princess Drink Package
howToChoose.subtitle: Use these tailored traveler profiles to quickly identify the best beverage option for your travel style.

profiles.title: Plus Beverage Package
profiles.description: Choose Plus if you enjoy a mix of cocktails, wine, beer, spirits and specialty non-alcoholic drinks, and your daily orders fit within the 15-drink daily limit.

profiles.title: Premier Beverage Package
profiles.description: Choose Premier if you prefer premium drinks, often order beverages above the Plus $15 price allowance, or want no daily limit on included alcoholic beverages.

profiles.title: Zero-Alcohol Package
profiles.description: Choose Zero-Alcohol if you do not drink alcohol but regularly enjoy mocktails, specialty coffees, gourmet teas, premium bottled water and Red Bull.

profiles.title: Classic Soda Package
profiles.description: Choose Classic Soda if your main interest is fountain soda, fruit juices, mocktails and smoothies without specialty espresso or alcohol.

profiles.title: No Package (À la Carte)
profiles.description: Choose no package if you drink occasionally, enjoy complimentary drinks, and expect your individual purchases to cost less than the daily package fee.

faqs.question: How much is a Princess Cruises drink package?
faqs.answer: Princess's beverage page currently lists a value of $64.99 per person, per day for the Plus Beverage Package and $84.99 for the Premier Beverage Package. It also lists the Zero-Alcohol Package at $29.99 and the Classic Soda Package at $14.99 per person, per day. Confirm the actual price and service charges for your sailing.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Plus and Premier Beverage Packages?
faqs.answer: Plus covers eligible drinks priced up to $15 USD and has a daily limit of 15 included beverages, with stated exceptions for specialty coffee, tea and bottled water. Premier covers eligible drinks up to $20 USD and has no daily limit on included alcoholic beverages under current terms.

faqs.question: Does Princess Plus include unlimited drinks?
faqs.answer: No. The Plus Beverage Package has a daily limit of 15 included beverages over a 24-hour period. Specialty coffees and teas do not count toward that limit, and qualifying bottled water has a separate daily allowance of up to 12 bottles.

faqs.question: Does Princess Premier have a drink limit?
faqs.answer: Princess Premier currently has no daily limit on included alcoholic beverages. All alcohol service remains subject to Princess's responsible-service policies and package conditions.

faqs.question: Are specialty coffees included in Princess drink packages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Eligible specialty coffees and teas are included in the Plus and Premier Beverage Packages and the Zero-Alcohol Package. Under Plus, specialty coffees and teas do not count toward the 15-beverage daily limit.

faqs.question: Is bottled water included in Princess drink packages?
faqs.answer: Selected still and sparkling bottled water in containers of 500 ml or less is included, subject to a limit of up to 12 bottles per day under the current Plus and Premier terms. Other sizes and products may be excluded or discounted.

faqs.question: Can I buy a Princess drink package for only a few days?
faqs.answer: Princess's published terms state that beverage packages must be purchased for the full length of the voyage. They are not designed for individual-day purchase.

faqs.question: Can two guests share one Princess drink package?
faqs.answer: No. Packages are assigned to individual guests and cannot be shared or transferred.

faqs.question: Does Princess Plus include alcohol?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Plus Beverage Package includes eligible cocktails, spirits, wine by the glass and beer priced up to $15 USD, subject to the daily beverage limit and other conditions.

faqs.question: Is the Princess Zero-Alcohol Package worth it?
faqs.answer: It may be worthwhile if you regularly order specialty coffees, mocktails, fountain sodas and premium water. If you mainly drink complimentary beverages, purchasing individual drinks may cost less.

faqs.question: Are Princess drink package prices inclusive of service charges?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Princess's beverage page states that published USD pricing excludes service charges and lists a 20% service charge for itineraries other than Australia. Check the terms for your specific voyage.

faqs.question: Can I use my Princess drink package before the ship reaches international waters?
faqs.answer: On sailings departing from certain US states, including California, New York and Washington, the alcoholic portion of the package does not take effect until the ship enters international waters. Non-alcoholic benefits may be treated differently under the applicable terms.
